notes.title: Space Hole 2020: 2024 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New 3rd person camera, adjustable with the right stick or mouse.  This brings the controls more in line with the other Space Hole games, and Extreme Evolution.  This new camera system applies to all the main, larger levels of Space Hole 2020, and in general makes the game much smoother to play. A goal of using fixed camera angles in Space Hole 2020 was to make the game easier to play.  Ultimately, the levels of Space Hole 2020 are much easier to navigate/explore with an adjustable camera.  Going forward, this will be the normal mode of Space Hole 2020; if you want to play the old isometric version, try the "classic" branch on Steam!

notes.title: It's (almost) time for Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity
notes.notes:
The spiritual successor to Space Hole 2018 is now announced! If you enjoy Space Hole (especially 2018) you'll love Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity.

This new game is a lot larger than any I've made before, and will be another collaboration with DL Salo's music! It's about biological transformation. Follow the steam page below or the join the space hole discord for all the updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111360/Extreme_Evolution_Drive_to_Divinity

notes.title: Space Hole 2020 travels past 2018 into the year 2020
notes.notes:
Beginning at the start of time and launching off towards the future, Space Hole 2020 is a video game about the year 2020.

Space Hole 2020 is the follow up to Space Hole 2018, available now on Steam.  
In 2020, new tech, such as the Freeform Machine, allows for a new level of psychedelic imagery.  Layered cameras, uncleared buffers, fmv, and dynamic audio combine to simulate the cosmic upheaval of Space Hole.  

The Space Hole 2020 demo features the Hole and Space levels, as well as the Freeform Machine, Electric Glass, and City experiences.
